your_book:
Wednesday's session left Jaleel's book fractionally mixed against a backdrop of broad sector rotation. The clearest bright spot was Adobe (ADBE), which surged 3.11% and is now the day's top contributor — meaningful given its ~5% weight, even though the position remains slightly underwater on a cost basis. Neurocrine Biosciences (NBIX) added 2.83% and NVIDIA (NVDA) ticked up 1.07%, with Bank of America flagging NVDA as a top semiconductor pick into year-end; the position sits at a healthy +13.2% unrealized gain. On the other side, Abbott (ABT) fell 2.01% — the steepest decliner by day-move — and its elevated risk flag (EPS guide trimmed, earnings Oct 13) makes that slide worth watching. Equifax (EFX) dropped 2.57% on what is already a -20.2% loss, compounding pain in a small but badly underwater slot. Danaher (DHR) shed 1.78% despite sitting on the book's second-largest unrealized gain at +23.6%.

The drift problem in this book remains structural. LULU (-24.7%), EFX (-20.2%), NVS (-12.2%), NBIX (-12.7%), ZTS (-11.2%), and BSX (-10.8%) are all rated Strong Buy or Buy yet are meaningfully offside — price and thesis are diverging across a wide swath of names. The portfolio's overall unrealized loss of -2.42% masks how many individual positions are deeper underwater than that aggregate suggests. RKLB at 7.2% weight with an AVOID verdict and a -10.8% loss remains the most structurally awkward position in the book.

Key catalysts to watch: ABT reports October 13, BSX October 28, and the pharma cluster (GILD, NVS, NBIX, VRTX) faces drug-pricing policy overhang with a policy date flagged October 22. ADBE's bounce today is encouraging but the AI-disruption narrative — not fundamentals — is driving that name, so don't confuse one good session with thesis vindication.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated at 7.2% weight, down 10.8% — largest misalignment in the book
attention.note: At the book's fifth-largest weight, holding a position the model explicitly rates AVOID with a near-11% loss and no risk flag resolution in sight is a direct contradiction of the capital-preservation mandate.

attention.headline: Down 20.2% and falling — -2.57% today adds to a deteriorating loss
attention.note: Despite a Strong Buy verdict and the highest QARP score in the book at 81.1, price action keeps punishing this position and there is no catalyst or next-event date provided to anchor a recovery thesis.

attention.headline: Guidance slashed, management guiding flat through Q3, earnings Oct 28
attention.note: At 8.6% weight and -10.8% unrealized, the next catalyst is a live earnings print in under four weeks where the bar has already been reset lower — the risk/reward around that date needs to be sized consciously.

attention.headline: Dropped 2.01% today with EPS guide already trimmed and earnings Oct 13
attention.note: The combination of today's decline, a flagged EPS outlook cut, and an imminent earnings date in 13 days means any further negative revision could accelerate losses in the book's second-largest holding.
